description: Source code for a POSIX-based hardware counter driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing counter functionalities such as start, stop, set alarm, set top value, and handling interrupts.

methods.name: schedule_next_isr
methods.description: Schedules the next interrupt based on current counter value and pending alarms.

methods.name: counter_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling counter events and alarms.

methods.name: ctr_init
methods.description: Initializes the counter device, sets up IRQ, and resets counter.

methods.name: is_any_alarm_pending
methods.description: Checks if any alarm is currently pending.

methods.name: ctr_set_top_value
methods.description: Sets the top value for the counter, handling wrap and alarms.

methods.name: ctr_set_alarm
methods.description: Sets an alarm on a specific channel.
